question: The value of 69 - 4 × [ 4 + 3 × { 20 - 5 ( 7 - 5 ) × 2} ÷ 29] is:
solution:
**Given:**

The value of 69 - 4 × [ 4 + 3 × { 20 - 5 ( 7 - 5 ) × 2} ÷ 29]

**Formula used:**

BODMAS Rule (Bracket, Order, Division/Multiplication, Addition/Subtraction)

**Calculations:**

69 - 4 × [ 4 + 3 × { 20 - 5 ( 7 - 5 ) × 2} ÷ 29]

⇒ 69 - 4 × [ 4 + 3 × { 20 - 5 × 2 × 2} ÷ 29]

⇒ 69 - 4 × [ 4 + 3 × { 20 - 20} ÷ 29]

⇒ 69 - 4 × [ 4 + 3 × 0 ÷ 29]

⇒ 69 - 4 × [ 4 + 0]

⇒ 69 - 4 × 4

⇒ 69 - 16

⇒ 53

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
